identity.en: A small, slight sixteen-year-old Chinese girl, a tea picker on a hillside tea plantation in 1920s Jiangnan
identity.text: 十六岁采茶姑娘，1920 年代江南茶山

face.en: Sun-tanned wheat-coloured skin tone, a round face with soft cheeks, gently curved eyes and eyebrows, a small nose, and a single dimple on her left cheek
face.text: 麦色的脸，圆脸，眉眼弯弯，左边一个酒窝

hair.en: One thick black braid coiled at the back of her head, wrapped in a faded blue cotton headscarf knotted at the nape
hair.text: 一条粗辫盘在脑后，包着洗褪色的蓝布头巾

build.en: Small and slight, with the sturdy, upright posture of someone who climbs hills every day
build.text: 个子小，常年爬山，站得结实挺直

skin.en: Young, sun-tanned skin with faint pores and a few light freckles across the nose, no makeup
skin.text: 年轻、晒黑的皮肤，鼻梁上几粒浅雀斑，素颜

top.en: a hand-woven indigo cotton jacket with a side-fastened diagonal front and cloth-knot buttons, sleeves rolled up to the forearms
top.text: 靛蓝粗布斜襟短袄，布扣，袖子挽到小臂

bottom.en: loose black cotton trousers tied at the ankles with cloth strips, and woven straw sandals
bottom.text: 黑布宽腿裤，裤脚用布条扎紧，草鞋

details.en: the knot of her faded blue cotton headscarf at the nape, with the coiled black braid showing beneath it
details.text: 脑后头巾的结与露出的盘辫

details.en: the small standing collar of her hand-woven indigo cotton jacket and the single cloth-knot button at her throat
details.text: 小立领与喉下那一颗布扣

details.en: the indigo cotton sleeve rolled up above the wrist, with brownish tea stains on the rolled edge
details.text: 挽起的袖口，沾着茶汁的印子

details.en: woven straw sandals and the black cotton trouser hems tied at the ankles with cloth strips
